description: Random sequence generator built from five planets orbiting one another around a central star, whose coordinates become control voltages

params.text: Sets the starting angle of that planet on its orbit, -180 to 180 degrees
Sets the distance from that planet to the one before it in the chain, 1 to 30
Sets how fast that planet turns, -180 to 180 degrees per second, orbiting the other way below zero
Puts every planet back at its starting angle
Multiplies the X coordinate of both selected planets before it reaches the X1 and X2 outputs, 0 to 3 times
Multiplies the Y coordinate of both selected planets before it reaches the Y1 and Y2 outputs, 0 to 3 times
Chooses which of the five planets feeds the X1 and Y1 outputs
Chooses which of the five planets feeds the X2 and Y2 outputs
Makes the X1 and X2 outputs carry the absolute value of the X coordinate, so they never fall below 0V
Makes the Y1 and Y2 outputs carry the absolute value of the Y coordinate, so they never fall below 0V

inputs.text: A rising edge above 1V puts every planet back at its starting angle

outputs.text: The X coordinate of the planet chosen for the first output pair, one tenth of its value multiplied by the X scale knob
The Y coordinate of the planet chosen for the first output pair, one tenth of its value multiplied by the Y scale knob
The X coordinate of the planet chosen for the second output pair, one tenth of its value multiplied by the X scale knob
The Y coordinate of the planet chosen for the second output pair, one tenth of its value multiplied by the Y scale knob
